caption: The drawing shows an ornamental wooden carving that features an intricate symmetrical design. The object is mainly brown, with shading and highlights that suggest a polished wooden surface. The central element is a vertical, elongated, and slightly pointed shape resembling the blade of a spear or stylized leaf. On either side of this central form, there are two large, textured leaves with visible veins, each accompanied by a smaller leaf below. Swirling vine-like tendrils and scrolls surround and connect the leaves, framing the central section and extending outward in curved forms. At the top left corner of the drawing, there is a small scale diagram labeled "1/8 = 1’," along with a quarter-circle indicating a corner detail. The background is off-white or beige, and a faint rectangular border frames the entire composition. The name "MAGNUS S. FOSSUM" is printed at the bottom.
title: Shelf (Corner Bracket)
